name: ec2-provisioning-build

source.buildspec:
version: 0.2
phases:
  install:
    commands:
      - terraform -version
  build:
    commands:
      - echo "Fetching tfvars for $ENVIRONMENT..."
      - aws s3 cp s3://tfvars-request-bucket/requests/$ENVIRONMENT.auto.tfvars.json ./examples/request.auto.tfvars.json
      - cd ec2-provisioning-terraform
      - terraform init -input=false
      - terraform workspace select $ENVIRONMENT || terraform workspace new $ENVIRONMENT
      - terraform plan  -input=false -var-file=../examples/request.auto.tfvars.json
      - terraform apply -auto-approve -input=false -var-file=../examples/request.auto.tfvars.json
artifacts:
  files:
    - '**/*'

description: Build triggered by CodePipeline; buildspec configured in source.buildspec.
